description: This file contains unit tests for multifaceted grain functionality in Orleans, testing interface references, type safety, factory methods, and interface argument passing.

classes.name: MultifacetGrainTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying multifaceted grain behavior in Orleans, including interface casting, factory methods, and argument passing.

methods.name: RWReferences
methods.description: Tests accessing a grain through different interface facets and verifies they operate on the same underlying grain.

methods.name: RWReferencesInvalidCastException
methods.description: Ensures that invalid interface casts throw InvalidCastException, maintaining type safety.

methods.name: MultifacetFactory
methods.description: Tests factory methods that return different facets of a grain, verifying correct interface references.

methods.name: Multifacet_InterfacesAsArguments
methods.description: Verifies passing grain interface references as method arguments and their validity.
